classes.name: Geom2dAdaptor
classes.summary: this package contains the geometric definition of 2d curves compatible with the Adaptor package templates.

staticMethods.name: MakeCurve
staticMethods.comment: Inherited from GHCurve. Provides a curve handled by reference. Creates a 2d curve from a HCurve2d. This cannot process the OtherCurves.

classes.name: Geom2dAdaptor_Curve
classes.summary:
An interface between the services provided by any curve from the package Geom2d and those required of the curve by algorithms which use it.
Polynomial coefficients of BSpline curves used for their evaluation are cached for better performance. Therefore these evaluations are not thread-safe and parallel evaluations need to be prevented.

instanceMethods.name: ShallowCopy
instanceMethods.comment: Shallow copy of adaptor.

instanceMethods.name: Reset
instanceMethods.comment: Reset currently loaded curve (undone `Load()`).

instanceMethods.name: Load
instanceMethods.signature: (theCurve: Geom2d_Curve, theUFirst: number, theULast: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Standard_ConstructionError is raised if theUFirst > theULast + `Precision::PConfusion()`.

instanceMethods.name: IsInitialized
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if the adaptor has been loaded with a curve.

instanceMethods.name: NbIntervals
instanceMethods.comment: If necessary, breaks the curve in intervals of continuity . And returns the number of intervals.

instanceMethods.name: Intervals
Trim
instanceMethods.signature: (First: number, Last: number, Tol: number): Adaptor2d_Curve2d
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a curve equivalent of <me> between parameters <First> and <Last>. <Tol> is used to test for 3d points confusion. If <First> >= <Last>.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: D0
instanceMethods.comment:
Computes the point of parameter U.
@param P Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: DN
instanceMethods.comment: The returned vector gives the value of the derivative for the order of derivation N. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not CN. Raised if N < 1.

instanceMethods.name: Resolution
instanceMethods.comment: returns the parametric resolution

instanceMethods.name: GetType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type of the curve in the current interval: Line, Circle, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Parabola, BezierCurve, BSplineCurve, OtherCurve.
